Looking for a prescriber?

The Trans Health SA directory lists GPs, clinics and services across South Australia. Your pharmacist can also tell you which local prescribers regularly prescribe gender-affirming hormones.

    No supply problems reported

      Pharmacy stock reports

      What registered pharmacists say is on their shelves right now, checked against the AHPRA register before publishing. The official data above tells you about Australia; this tells you about particular pharmacies.

      See all pharmacy stock reports   Pharmacists: post a report →

      Seen it in stock, or missed out?

      Reports from other patients about what their local pharmacy had on the shelf. This sits alongside the official data above until a verified pharmacy stock feed is in place.

      Anonymous. No account, no personal details, and please don't put a person's name in the note.

      If your medicine is affected

      Start with your pharmacist — they can check other suppliers, order it in, and for the oestrogen patches can often supply an approved alternative without a new prescription. Filling your script a few days early, rather than on the last day, gives everyone room to move.

      Overview guide

      Fertility, PrEP and surgery

      Care that sits alongside gender-affirming hormone therapy: fertility before you start, sexual function, PrEP, and hormones around surgery. It is background reading, not a prescription. Blood tests and reviews are on the Blood tests and monitoring page.

      Pharmacy stock reports

      Stock reports posted by registered pharmacists, newest first. Each pharmacist's registration number is checked against the AHPRA register before their first report is published; after that their reports appear straight away.

      Post a report

      For pharmacists, and pharmacy staff posting on a pharmacist's behalf. Your name, registration number and work email (if you give one) are stored, and only the author can see them. Your registration number is never shown. The pharmacy name, suburb, medicine, stock position and note are public. To correct or remove a report, use the feedback page (preferred) or email gamsaenquiries@gmail.com.

      Your registration number, name, pharmacy, suburb and report key are remembered on this device for your next report; the report itself is not.

      Not for promoting your pharmacy: report stock facts only. By posting you confirm you are a registered pharmacist, or are posting with one's permission, and that the report is accurate at the time of posting. Reports expire after 14 days.

      The spam check could not load, so this form cannot send. A content blocker or privacy setting may be stopping it. Allow challenges.cloudflare.com for gamsa.au, or try another browser.

      Send feedback

      Spotted something wrong, out of date or missing? Tell us here. Every message is read, and corrections are made as quickly as possible. The form is the preferred way to reach us; if you cannot use it, email gamsaenquiries@gmail.com.

      Please do not include personal health details. Messages are stored privately and never shared, and no tracking cookies are used.
